name: Weekender
tagline: Three nights, somewhere you'd never have picked
reach: Within North America, up to a 4-hour flight
best_for: A long weekend, a first surprise trip
includes:
Round-trip flights from your home airport
Three nights in a hand-picked boutique hotel
One booked experience, from a food tour to a sunrise paddle
Your sealed envelope and clue card
A pocket guide written for your trip
not_included:
Meals other than breakfast
Travel insurance
description: Three nights, somewhere you'd never have picked. You tell us your dates, your airport and what you love. We pick the place, book everything and send you a sealed envelope that you open at the airport.
